scope: static packaging of the first XNU kernel entry candidate; no device action
success_requires: menu shows the xnu entry and DarwinBoot either reports the window outcome on screen or the kernel console appears; a fastboot ACK alone is not a process log

adt_detail.stdout: nuwa ADT: 13120 bytes, dram 0x240000000 @ 0x8c0000000, 8 cpu(s), timebase 19200000 Hz
adt_detail.note: no RAMDisk/TrustCache/GpuAddon placeholder, so the loader takes the no-sidecar path in DarwinBoot.c:561-567

ui.title: NUWA XNU FIRST ENTRY - ANALYSIS BUILD

expected_screen_outcomes: menu shows the xnu entry, then NO WINDOW <size> BIG RUN <bytes> @ <addr> plus FREE rows: the window request was rejected and the UEFI memory map is now known
any other line from DarwinBoot before the handoff, e.g. unsupported inputs or exception level
a kernel console or panic screen: the window was granted and the kernel was entered
recovery: the original stock boot is preserved as the image header; after the trial the stock boot is loaded back and Android must report boot_completed=1 with the same boot_a/vendor_boot_a/init_boot_a digests
not_proven: that the analysis prelink is loadable: it is explicitly loadable=false and runtime_qualified=false
that the UEFI memory map can satisfy a 1 GiB contiguous window
that the kernel reaches userspace or boots iOS
